measurement.xdist_caveat: Under -n auto --dist loadfile the suite retains a PARALLEL-ONLY flake: ~1 worker 'not properly terminated' near 99%, occasionally an xdist INTERNALERROR. NOT a deterministically-hanging test (sequential completes clean). Root cause is resource/timing contention across ~14 workers + a slow test tripping --timeout-method=thread. Recommended: run the broad suite sequentially or with reduced -n in CI; the core release gate is unaffected.

network_policy.what: Root-conftest socket.socket replacement (_VOSLoopbackOnlySocket): permits loopback + AF_UNIX, fast-fails external connects (clean OSError; connect_ex returns ECONNREFUSED).
network_policy.why: The leaked W5/W6 import-time socket guards used to (accidentally) air-gap the whole suite. Once correctly scoped per-test, real external connects (HF/Stripe/Convex) began hanging and crashing xdist workers. This makes the no-internet expectation explicit and deterministic. Does NOT relax any security assertion.
